title: Source ownership
responsibility: Lists an entity's implementation files at the selected revision, using its real category folder.

inputs.name: EntitySource.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with recorded owned source paths and optional revision-bound responsibility category.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Category-folder implementation paths, falling back to recorded paths for framework entries and uncategorized revisions. Empty ownership is explicit. Symbols, execution targets and identity/version metadata are omitted. Does not fetch file contents or rename paths.
